name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Ctx.of_agree
typeText:
∀ {m m' : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem} {V : List.{0} Nat},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Ctx m →
    DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Agree m m' V →
      (∀ (x : Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} V x → LE.le.{0} 5 x) → DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Ctx m'

source.code:
theorem Ctx.of_agree {m m' : Mem} {V : List ℕ} (h : Ctx m) (ha : Agree m m' V)
    (hV : ∀ x, x ∈ V → 5 ≤ x) : Ctx m' := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, le_trans h3 ha.2⟩
  · rw [ha.var ONE (by addr') (by addr') (fun h => by have := hV _ h; addr'), h1]
  · rw [ha.var ZERO (by addr') (by addr') (fun h => by have := hV _ h; addr'), h2]
